title: Labor Day Double Station Cash weekend
names_seen: Labor Day Double Station Cash weekend

facts.statement: Station Cash purchases were doubled during the Labor Day weekend promotion, valid from 12:01 AM PDT on 2012-09-01 to 11:59 PM PDT on 2012-09-03.
facts.quote: ¡Obtener DOBLE STATION CASH entre 01 de septiembre y 3 de septiembre de 2012!

article_summaries.title: Fin de semana del Día del Trabajo Doble Station Cash!
article_summaries.summary: An official Free Realms news post (page text in Spanish, site in French) announcing a Labor Day weekend promotion that doubled Station Cash purchases from September 1 to September 3, 2012. It states the offer's exact window and which purchase channels qualify, and excludes SMS Station Cash purchases. The article does not name the publication date beyond a relative 'published 2 months, 2 days ago' stamp relative to capture.
